items.name: Anthropic
items.summary: Anthropic, PBC filed a public S-1 on Oct 26, 2026 (accession 0001628280-26-067168), Amendment No. 1 on Nov 2, 2026 (accession 0001628280-26-068676), and Amendment No. 2 on Nov 10, 2026 (accession 0001628280-26-072484, CIK 2130357): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026072484/anthropicpbc-sx1ax2.htm. On Nov 10 the company also launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO: https://www.anthropic.com/news/roadshow-launch. Anthropic has applied to list Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the proposed symbol ANT. The expected IPO price is $70.00 to $78.00 per share. The offering is 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, of which 801,351,354 are being offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 by selling stockholders. Anthropic also expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to buy up to 123,750,000 more shares. Those terms are in Amendment No. 2 and in Anthropic's roadshow announcement, and were also reported by CNBC and by Reuters (via Investing.com). The Nov 2 amendment's quarterly table, in millions, prints Q3 2026 revenue of 16,956, Q2 2026 revenue of 11,555, nine-month 2026 revenue of 33,242, a Q3 net loss of 23,291, a Q2 net loss of 66,309, a Q3 operating loss of 567, and Q2 operating income of 974. Compute purchase commitments in that amendment were approximately $895.4 billion as of and subsequent to September 30, 2026. The Nov 2 amendment anticipates a US retail selling group that includes Charles Schwab, Fidelity, Robinhood, Trade-PMR, SoFi, and E*TRADE. Anthropic's IPO help page, checked Nov 10, 2026, lists these firms as expected to participate in a proposed Canadian retail offering: BMO Capital Markets, CIBC Capital Markets, RBC Capital Markets, Scotiabank, TD Securities and Wealthsimple: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17889756-anthropic-ipo-international-retail-brokers-and-selling-agents. Names that page shares with a Nov 3, 2026 MT Newswires report (https://ttm.financial/m/news/2680749742) are RBC Capital Markets, TD Securities and Wealthsimple. An allocation is not guaranteed. Access, eligibility, minimums and size depend on the broker. CNBC, citing people familiar with the plans who were not authorized to speak publicly, reported a plan to price on Nov 18 and trade on Nov 19. Those dates are not in Anthropic's roadshow announcement and are not confirmed.
